description: Read a document by id or name -- version defaults to the current one; text: true also returns the extracted plain text this document's mime produced at put time.

id.description: Document id to read; use name instead if you don't have it.

name.description: Document name to read; use id instead if you have it.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

text.description: Also return the extracted plain text; default false.

version.description: Version to read; defaults to the document's current version.

name: host.docs.get
